experienceHighlights.text: Rewrote the task‑allocation service in C++ to use travel‑time based assignment.
experienceHighlights.witness: Rewrote the task‑allocation service in C++ at Brannock Automation so that robots are assigned picks by estimated travel time rather than straight‑line distance.

experienceHighlights.text: Extended the Python layout simulator with one‑way aisle rules and charger queues, and validated customer layouts before floor‑plan changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Added one‑way aisle rules and charger queues to the Python layout simulator, and ran each customer's proposed layout through it before the site engineers changed the floor plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote a field diagnostics command that dumps a stalled robot's path plan and sensor state, and joined the weekday support rota for site engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote a field diagnostics command that dumps a stalled robot's path plan and sensor state, and joined the weekday support rota for site engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Followed the company's safety‑related software process, including hazard‑log entries, code review by a second engineer, and test reports filed for the safety case.
experienceHighlights.witness: Followed the company's safety‑related software process for the allocation service: hazard‑log entries, code review by a second engineer and test reports filed for the safety case.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Telemetry comparison report for Daventry and Leeds sites, showing idle‑time tables for baseline and post‑change fortnights, fleet manager's definition of idle time, allocation release date, and acknowledgements from site operations managers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the telemetry comparison report for the two sites, with idle‑time tables for the baseline and post‑change fortnights (14.0% and 9.6% of shift time), the fleet manager's definition of idle time, the allocation release date (13 March 2023) and acknowledgements from both site operations managers.

skills.witness: Rewrote the task‑allocation service in C++ at Brannock Automation so that robots are assigned picks by estimated travel time rather than straight‑line distance.
Added one‑way aisle rules and charger queues to the Python layout simulator, and ran each customer's proposed layout through it before the site engineers changed the floor plan.

At the Daventry and Leeds customer sites, robot idle time went from 14.0% of shift time in the baseline fortnight (6 to 19 February 2023) to 9.6% after the new allocation went into service (20 March to 2 April 2023), measured from fleet telemetry.
Wrote a field diagnostics command that dumps a stalled robot's path plan and sensor state, and joined the weekday support rota for site engineers.
